title: Sketches from Old Sturbridge Village
content: Here are some pencil sketches that I did in 1987 at Old Sturbridge Village in Massachusetts, where they recreate the life of an American small town in the early 19th century.Damon Cook, cooperNotching an oak beam before hewing.Hewing with a broadaxeSome tools of the trade, all made on-siteJohn Eaton, tinner, making a betty lamp.Old Sturbridge Village website
